title: Binance Futures Will Postpone the Updates on Tick Size for Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts (2025-08-04)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The time for the updates on tick size for multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts, originally set at 2025-08-01 07:00 (UTC), will be postponed to  2025-08-04 07:00 (UTC) . For More Information: Updates on Tick Size for Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts (2025-08-01) Note :  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-08-01
